items.q: What exactly does Osify do?
items.a: Osify analyses growth data, test results, visit records and left-hand radiology images of patients, and provides them as smart charts and reports to physicians so that they can make more accurate and faster clinical decisions.

items.q: For whom is Osify designed?
items.a: The Osify platform is designed for pediatric endocrinology and metabolism subspecialists, pediatricians, clinic managers, receptionists and physician assistants. Each group has its own dedicated workspace with tools and access level appropriate for their role.

items.q: What role does artificial intelligence play in Osify?
items.a: Osify’s AI algorithms analyse growth data, test results and left-hand radiology images and automatically calculate indices such as BMI, SDS, HV, WV, AHP, MPH and Bone Age. The physician can use these analyses to evaluate the growth trend and make more precise therapeutic decisions.

items.q: Do I need to install any special software to use Osify?
items.a: No. You don’t need to install any software to use Osify. The Osify platform is completely web-based and you can run it through your browser.

items.q: How do physicians use Osify?
items.a: The physician creates a file for each patient, and records visits and test results using OCR technology. Osify automatically updates the growth chart and analyses the patient’s changes compared to previous visits. Also, by uploading a left-hand radiology image, the system calculates bone age with AI.

items.q: How does Osify help clinics?
items.a: Osify unifies all processes of registration, follow-up and patient analysis in one integrated environment. Clinic managers can manage multiple physicians and receptionists in a single system, distribute files among physicians and view performance reports and patient treatment trends comprehensively.

items.q: Can I use Osify on a mobile phone too?
items.a: Yes. The web version of Osify is fully responsive and can be used on mobile and computer without needing to install an app.

items.q: Can I view previous growth records or visits of patients?
items.a: Yes. In the dashboard of each patient you can view all previous growth records, visits and registered data. The information is displayed in an organised and filterable way so you can examine the growth trend or changes in the patient over different time intervals.

items.q: How is user authentication handled?
items.a: Registration in Osify only happens after official identity verification and approval of medical credentials. The system automatically recognises the user’s role and sets the access level, tools and visible data based on that role.

items.q: How is patient data security guaranteed?
items.a: All data are stored with advanced encryption methods and only authorised treatment team members have access. Data storage is performed in accordance with privacy standards and no one will access them without a physician’s permission.

items.q: What happens if my account is deactivated or I leave?
items.a: Patient data are never deleted. Physicians and clinic managers can export a full set of their data prior to deactivation of the account. Information is securely stored until final disposition and only the account owner (or clinic manager) has access.

items.q: Who has access to my patient information?
items.a: Only you have access to your patients’ information, unless you explicitly give your receptionist or assistants a defined access level. Receptionists only have the ability to record and edit basic patient information and do not access medical details or specialist analyses.

items.q: What is the difference between Osify’s plans?
items.a: Osify’s plans are designed based on user role (sub-specialist physician, specialist or clinic manager) and level of features. The professional and advanced plans offer more precise analytical features, higher capacity in patient management, and the ability to define more assistants. To get better familiarity, you can start with the 14-day free trial and experience the features of each plan before deciding.

items.q: What if I want to change my plan?
items.a: You can upgrade your plan at any time. The system automatically calculates the remaining credit and subtracts it from the cost of the new plan.

items.q: After the trial ends, will my data be lost?
items.a: No. Your data are always preserved. Only some advanced features will be disabled until you renew.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time and you can easily receive the remaining credit of your subscription.

items.q: What should I do if a problem occurs?
items.a: Through the in-app support (online chat) you can communicate with the Osify team. During working hours responses are instantaneous and outside working hours your request is registered and reviewed at the earliest opportunity.

items.q: Does Osify provide phone support?
items.a: Yes. Users of the professional and advanced plans have access to dedicated phone support.

items.q: How can I export data or reports?
items.a: In each patient’s file there is an option “Export as PDF or Excel” so you can save or print the full report of growth, tests and visits.

items.q: Is data transfer from another software possible?
items.a: Yes. Using CSV or Excel files you can import previous patient data into Osify in a few simple steps.
